description: Ghostchars: clean a piece of text. Removes invisible Unicode characters (zero-width spaces, word joiners, bidi controls, smuggled tag characters) and, at bar "text", normalises machine-writing typography to ASCII. Returns the whole cleaned text plus one finding per character it touched. Run it over any prose you are about to ship: documentation, a commit message, a pull request description, a release note, a UI string. Nothing leaves this machine.

bar.description: How hard to clean. "text" (the default) removes invisible characters and normalises typography: no-break spaces to plain spaces, em and en dashes, curly quotes and ellipsis characters to ASCII. Use "text" for anything a person will read. "default" removes only invisible characters and leaves typography alone; use it for text you are quoting from somewhere else. "max" also folds look-alike Cyrillic and Greek letters and applies NFKC, which rewrites letters and is lossy. Do not use "max" on text you did not write.

max_findings.description: Cap on the findings list and on the rewrite sites. The cleaned text is never truncated.

options.description: Precise per-option overrides. The bar sets the baseline and these can only turn individual options on. Leave this out unless you need a specific option.

aggressive.description: strip glue characters (zero-width joiner, variation selectors, tag characters) even where they are doing real work, which breaks emoji sequences and some scripts

bidi.description: strip bidi marks and isolates even next to right-to-left text

collapse.description: collapse a run of two or more spaces inside a line to one

confusables.description: map look-alike Cyrillic and Greek letters to Latin inside mixed-script words

controls.description: strip C0 and C1 control characters, keeping tab and the line endings

gutters.description: strip the quote bar a terminal draws at the start of a line (U+258C to U+258F, U+2502, U+2503) and one space after it, keeping indentation and box-drawn tables

newlines.description: fold every line ending to a plain newline

nfc.description: NFC-normalise the text before anything else runs

nfkc.description: NFKC-normalise first. Rewrites letters, and supersedes --nfc

pua.description: strip private-use characters, which breaks icon fonts

punct.description: em and en dashes, curly quotes, ellipsis and minus to ASCII

spaces.description: no-break and other exotic spaces to a plain space

trailing.description: strip trailing spaces and tabs at the end of every line

text.description: The text to clean. Returned unchanged if it is already clean.

name: clean_text

changed.description: True when cleaning would alter the text.

cleaned.description: The full cleaned text. Omitted when changed is false.

findings.description: One entry per suspicious character, in document order.

rewrite_sites.description: Dash positions where rewriting the sentence beats the mechanical substitution.

rewrite_sites_total.description: How many rewrite sites the text holds, whether or not the list above was capped.
